info.headline: Flood Warning for Condamine River downstream of Oakey Creek to Cotswold and Condamine River at Condamine
info.description:
Along the Condamine River downstream of Oakey Creek to Cotswold, minor flooding has eased at Condamine. Minor flooding is occurring at Cotswold.
The Condamine River at Condamine peaked at 6.10 m around 9:15 am Wednesday, with minor flooding. The river is currently at 4.40 m and falling, below the minor flood level (5.00 m). The Condamine River at Condamine is expected to remain below the minor flood level (5.00 m).
info.instruction:
* Don't drive, walk, swim or play in floodwater because it is dangerous. * Stay away from flooded drains, rivers, streams and waterways. * Obey road closure signs. Plan ahead so you don't drive on flooded roads. * Check the ABC and local media for updates. The situation can change quickly, so stay informed. * For local emergency management warnings and advice visit www.disaster.qld.gov.au/warnings.
For emergency assistance call SES on telephone number 132 500. In life-threatening emergencies, call 000 (triple zero) immediately.
